verses.text: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
lines: Yahweh, the God of my salvation,
I have cried day and night before you.

verses.text: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
lines: Let my prayer enter into your presence.
Turn your ear to my cry.

verses.text: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
lines: For my soul is full of troubles.
My life draws near to Sheol.

verses.text: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
lines: I am counted among those who go down into the pit.
I am like a man who has no help,

verses.text: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
lines: set apart among the dead,
like the slain who lie in the grave,
whom you remember no more.
They are cut off from your hand.

verses.text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
lines: You have laid me in the lowest pit,
in the darkest depths.

verses.text: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
lines: Your wrath lies heavily on me.
You have afflicted me with all your waves.

verses.text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
lines: You have taken my friends from me.
You have made me an abomination to them.
I am confined, and I can’t escape.

verses.text: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
lines: My eyes are dim from grief.
I have called on you daily, Yahweh.
I have spread out my hands to you.

verses.text: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you?
lines: Do you show wonders to the dead?
Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you?

verses.text: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
lines: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave?
Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

verses.text: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
lines: Are your wonders made known in the dark?
Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.text: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
lines: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried.
In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

verses.text: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
lines: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul?
Why do you hide your face from me?

verses.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
lines: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up.
While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

verses.text: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
lines: Your fierce wrath has gone over me.
Your terrors have cut me off.

verses.text: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
lines: They came around me like water all day long.
They completely engulfed me.

verses.text: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
lines: You have put lover and friend far from me,
and my friends into darkness.
